evidence.snippet: The mechanism of disease is proposed to be gain of function, not haploinsufficiency

evidence.reference_title: Mutations in the 5' UTR of ANKRD26, the ankirin repeat domain 26 gene, cause an autosomal-dominant form of inherited thrombocytopenia, THC2.
evidence.snippet: We identified six different ANKRD26 mutations, which were clustered in a highly conserved 19 bp sequence located in the 5' untranslated region.

evidence.reference_title: Mutations in ANKRD26 are responsible for a frequent form of inherited thrombocytopenia: analysis of 78 patients from 21 families.
evidence.snippet: Because THC2 affected 21 of the 210 families in our database, it has to be considered one of the less rare forms of inherited thrombocytopenia.

evidence.reference_title: Familial thrombocytopenia due to a complex structural variant resulting in a WAC-ANKRD26 fusion transcript.
evidence.snippet: Through functional studies, we show that this structural variant results in a pathogenic gain-of-function WAC-ANKRD26 fusion transcript.

nodes.description: A heterozygous single nucleotide substitution in the ANKRD26 5' UTR removes the binding sites for RUNX1 and FLI1. In healthy megakaryocytes, RUNX1 and FLI1 bound at this element switch ANKRD26 off during the late stages of megakaryopoiesis and platelet production.

nodes.description: Patient bone marrow shows expansion of megakaryocyte progenitors with a marked reduction of polyploid megakaryocytes. Elevated ANKRD26, which localizes to the centrosome, induces apoptosis of polyploid megakaryocytes by JUNB-mediated activation of CDKN1A (p21), independent of the p53-PIDDosome axis. Megakaryocytes are more numerous but smaller with hypolobulated nuclei, the dysmegakaryopoiesis seen on marrow examination.

nodes.description: The thrombopoietin receptor agonist eltrombopag raised the platelet count in seven of eight evaluable ANKRD26-RT patients in a phase II trial, mostly as minor responses, enough to avoid platelet transfusion before most surgery. Because carriers are predisposed to myeloid malignancy and ANKRD26-high cells are hypersensitive to eltrombopag in vitro, caution is advised, especially with long-term use.

nodes.description: ANKRD26 is normally expressed in early erythroid, megakaryocyte and granulocyte progenitors, where it is needed for proliferation, and is progressively silenced as the cells mature. In THC2 it stays expressed in maturing megakaryocytes and platelets, an ectopic temporal expression. ANKRD26 binds the homodimeric type I cytokine receptors MPL, EPOR and G-CSFR.
